extracted.intended_audience: authors and editors of Cochrane systematic reviews of interventions (review teams preparing or maintaining Cochrane reviews)
extracted.subtask_description: Official methodological guidance for preparing and maintaining Cochrane systematic reviews of interventions, covering core standards (MECIR), planning, searching, data collection, bias assessment, analysis, GRADE, and specialised topics. Intended to be consulted by all authors of Cochrane reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Methodological Expectations for Cochrane Intervention Reviews (MECIR) — core standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Key aspects of Handbook guidance are collated as the Methodological Expectations for Cochrane Intervention Reviews (MECIR). These provide core standards that are generally expected of Cochrane reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each MECIR item includes a link to a relevant Handbook chapter; MECIR items summarize the Handbook guidance into core standards for conduct and reporting of Cochrane intervention reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Planning a review
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on planning a review is part of the standard methods applicable to every review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Handbook contains detailed advice on the planning stage (scope, objectives, eligibility criteria, protocols) that authors should follow to prepare a Cochrane review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Searching and selecting studies
rubrics_metrics.description: Searching and selecting studies is listed as a standard method applicable to every review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Handbook provides detailed procedures for designing search strategies, searching databases and registers, screening records, and documenting selection decisions to ensure comprehensiveness and transparency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data collection
rubrics_metrics.description: Data collection is included among the standard methods applicable to every review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance covers designing data extraction forms, double data extraction/verification, handling missing or unclear data, and recording study characteristics and outcomes consistently.

rubrics_metrics.name: Risk of bias assessment
rubrics_metrics.description: Risk of bias assessment is a core standard and standard method for every review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Handbook gives procedures and tools for assessing risk of bias in included studies (including domain-based assessments), interpretation of bias judgments, and how to incorporate bias assessments into synthesis and conclusions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statistical analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: Statistical analysis is one of the standard methods applicable to every review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance includes choice of effect measures, meta-analysis models, handling heterogeneity, subgroup and sensitivity analyses, and appropriate statistical methods for synthesis of trial data.

rubrics_metrics.name: GRADE and interpreting results
rubrics_metrics.description: GRADE and interpreting results are included among the standard methods applicable to every review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Handbook gives guidance on using GRADE to assess certainty/quality of evidence and on interpreting and presenting results, including considerations for strength of conclusions and clinical/contextual interpretation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-randomized studies
rubrics_metrics.description: Specialised guidance is provided for reviews that include non-randomized studies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Handbook contains methods specific to design, risk of bias assessment, and synthesis of non-randomized evidence, reflecting different threats to validity compared with randomized trials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adverse effects
rubrics_metrics.description: Specialised guidance on identifying and synthesising evidence about adverse effects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Handbook discusses approaches to searching for harms, extracting adverse events data, and analysing and interpreting safety information alongside benefits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complex interventions
rubrics_metrics.description: Specialised guidance on reviews of complex interventions is included.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Handbook provides methods for defining, categorising, and synthesising complex interventions, and for addressing heterogeneity arising from multi-component or context-sensitive interventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equity
rubrics_metrics.description: Specialised guidance on considering equity in systematic reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Handbook advises on identifying, extracting and interpreting evidence relevant to health equity, including subgroup analyses and contextual factors affecting disadvantaged populations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economics
rubrics_metrics.description: Specialised guidance on economic evidence and analysis in reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Handbook covers including, extracting, and synthesising cost and economic evaluations and integrating economic considerations into interpretation of review findings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patient-reported outcomes
rubrics_metrics.description: Specialised guidance on identifying and using patient-reported outcomes in reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance addresses selection, measurement, and synthesis of patient-reported outcome measures and how to interpret their clinical relevance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Individual patient data (IPD)
rubrics_metrics.description: Specialised guidance on conducting reviews using individual patient data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Handbook provides methods for IPD acquisition, management, analysis (including one-stage and two-stage methods), and how IPD can inform subgroup and interaction analyses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prospective meta-analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: Specialised guidance on prospective meta-analysis methods.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Handbook includes advice on planning, coordinating, and analysing prospective meta-analyses where studies are identified and pooled prospectively according to a predefined protocol.

rubrics_metrics.name: Qualitative research
rubrics_metrics.description: Specialised guidance on incorporating qualitative research in reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Handbook covers methods for identifying, appraising, extracting, and synthesising qualitative evidence and integrating qualitative findings with quantitative review components.
